GOOD TO KNOW

Existing recording connections keep exactly their file names. One change: when a call has a second recording, its name now gets -2 after the call id (-3 for a third), where before the second replaced the first on SFTP and FTP and was taken for the same call by CallBI.

Yaxxa AI voices take no free-text speaking style. A style saved on the Yaxxa AI connection is no longer sent (it made the server refuse the whole request); prompts made with one are made again once. The whisper tick is the only style.

A voice described by its tags can sound a little different each time. For an agent or a campaign, use a saved voice, a gallery voice, or Save as a voice.

The HoduCC import: when HoduCC answers the ticket list with a bare server error, the import now tries the next date layout, and when nothing works the run says which layouts were tried and the start of what HoduCC said.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

File names for each destination: on each Marketplace connection that receives recordings (Vela, CallBI, SFTP, FTP), File names chooses the campaign's format, one format for this destination, or the connection's own template, with an example as you go. The ready-made formats "Vela import" and "CallBI import" give exactly today's names. Make a format from this connection's template turns a template into a format. Vela's details file can include what you tick.

Recording file name formats have two new settings: which characters are kept, and what to write when a part is empty. The formats page lists the connections that use each format.

Choosing a Yaxxa AI voice: the gallery searches and filters on the Yaxxa AI server by group, gender, age, pitch, accent, language and whisper. Listen plays a sample before a voice is added (the first time can take up to a minute), and Use this voice can take up to a minute the first time. Describe a voice has ten accents. Save as a voice keeps a described voice as a saved voice, so it sounds the same every time."}
